Class BlueJMethodScanner

java.lang.Object
tt.uwi.collection.BlueJMethodScanner
public class BlueJMethodScanner extends Object
Scans BlueJ projects, packages, and compiled classes to track declared method signatures in the method inventory.

  • Method Details

    • scanOpenProjects

      public void scanOpenProjects()
      Scans every package in each currently open BlueJ project. A project that closes during scanning is reported and skipped.

    • scanPackage

      public void scanPackage(bluej.extensions2.BPackage bluejPackage)
      Scans all classes in a package and removes tracked method inventory for classes that are no longer in the package. Package access failures are written to standard error.
      Parameters:
      bluejPackage - the package to scan
